title: Civil Terrain, Hydrology & Land-Transformation Runtime
objective: Implement Project-backed terrain and hydrology change proposals for excavation, fill, grading, tunneling, embankments, channels, reservoirs, irrigation, drainage and reclamation; bind MCS geometry and PCA analysis, validate against World/Environment owner state, commit only through owner operations, preserve provenance/original state, and build owner-defined compensation/recovery without creating a terrain, hydrology, Project, World or provenance ledger.
acceptance: Terrain/hydrology transformations remain proposals until Project/resource/time and World/Environment owners authorize commit.
Excavation/fill/grading/tunneling/embankment/channel/reservoir/irrigation/drainage/reclamation operations use explicit accepted definitions and owner references.
MCS geometry and PCA analysis remain noncanonical preview/analysis inputs and cannot silently mutate terrain or water state.
Stale or conflicting World/Environment/Project evidence fails closed or requires revalidation.
Committed transformations preserve original-state/history/provenance and recovery uses owner-defined compensation rather than history deletion.
Consequence observations/Events are typed for later MSWI routing without direct unrelated-domain mutation.
Blocking workflows remain semantic/nonvisual, keyboard-capable and provider-off.
boundaries: World/Environment owners retain canonical terrain, water and condition truth.
APW/D26 retains Project/task/time authority; D17/Inventory and MIB-12 retain resource/transformation truth.
MCS retains geometry/map authoring; PCA-12/Packet-08 retains generic analysis authority.
MBES-12 creates no terrain, hydrology, Project, World, Inventory, economy or provenance ledger.
MBES-14 and later MBES tranches remain unauthorized until canonical MBES-12 closeout.
next_action: MBES-12 is completed_verified. MBES-14 — Environment Conditions, Externalities, Habitability & Reactive-World Integration — is selected_not_started and requires a later owner Continue for governed start.
